name: design-deploy
description: >- Processes GCP infrastructure design and deployment workflows. Use when: - Designing GCP infrastructure with Terraform. - Validating local HCL. - Performing best-practice plan scans. - Importing templates to Application Design Center (ADC). - Deploying templates. - Troubleshooting deployment failures. Don't use for non-GCP cloud providers, or general Terraform coding outside the ADC context.
author: google
summary_zh: 面向 GCP 的基础设施设计与部署工具，适合用 Terraform 校验配置、扫描方案、导入 ADC 模板及排查部署故障。
